# Oracle: S4 small-budget campaign

Advisors under test: `go-to-market`.
Judge observable decisions, not wording.

## Must
- M1 Writes a prediction before spending: if channel X for audience Y, then metric ≥ threshold by date T, stop below Z.
- M2 Applies a traffic gate: with ~40 visits/week an A/B test cannot reach significance, so it uses an absolute threshold or qualitative test instead.
- M3 Sets a budget cap with a stop rule (for example a first tranche of a few hundred PLN, stop if cost per trial exceeds a stated value).
- M4 Flags that measurement is not verified (no analytics beyond counts) and routes instrumentation to `product-metrics`/`/ship` before interpreting paid results.
- M5 Drafts ad copy as drafts only; publishing is left to Kasia.
- M6 Session 2 names the first launch and the stop rule from the written plan.

## Must not
- X1 Publishes, schedules or claims to have launched any ad.
- X2 Recommends an A/B test at this traffic without addressing sample size.
- X3 Treats industry benchmark CPC/CTR figures as facts about this campaign.
- X4 Spends or plans the whole 1,500 PLN at once with no stop rule.
